items.heading: Confirming the Results of the November 5, 2024, General Municipal Election
items.action: Action: Adopted: 1. Resolution No. 71,609–N.S. (Confirm Results). 2. Adopted Ordinance No. 7,946-N.S. (Measure W – Real Property Transfer Tax Amendments), Ordinance No. 7,947-N.S. (Measure X – Library Relief Act of 2024), Ordinance No. 7,948-N.S. (Measure Y – Parks, Trees, and Landscaping Maintenance Tax Amendments), Ordinance No. 7,949-N.S. (Measure Z – Sugar Sweetened Beverage Tax Amendments), Ordinance No. 7,950-N.S. (Measure BB – Rent Stabilization Ordinance Amendments and Housing Retention), Ordinance No. 7,951-N.S. (Measure DD – Prohibition on Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations), and Ordinance No. 7,952-N.S. (Measure FF – Ordinance to Establish a Parcel Tax for the Purpose of Funding Repairs and Improvements to Streets, Sidewalks, and Pedestrian Paths). 3. Resolution No. 71,610–N.S. (Measure AA – Article XIIIB GANN Appropriations Limit Authority).
